youtube.description:
4 Kiro credit myths, busted (Oct 2026)

Four Kiro credit myths, busted.

1. Credits roll over - Nope. Unused credits don't roll over.
2. Every model costs the same - Nope. It ranges from point zero five to over two times.
3. Autopilot picks the model - Nope. Autopilot controls approvals. Auto picks the model.
4. Free means unlimited - Nope. The free tier is 50 credits.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/pricing
